title: Spiders May Sleep in Two Stages
paragraphs: Scientists studied a small jumping spider. It lives in Australia. The spider is about as big as a coin.
The scientists filmed the spiders at night. They saw something new. The spiders slept, and they had two kinds of sleep.
In one kind, the spiders moved their eyes. Their legs also moved a little. This looks like human dream sleep. But the scientists cannot say that spiders dream.

questions.q: What kind of animal did the scientists study?
When did they film the spiders?
Can the scientists say that spiders dream?
